;This program scans a small array of 4 numbers stored in
; RAM starting at 40H and finds the largest value, saving it in R5.

ORG 0000H
MOV R0, #40H      ; Point R0 to start of the array
MOV R2, #04H      ; Set loop counter for 4 items
MOV A, #00H       ; Clear Accumulator (acts as the current maximum)

CHECK:
CLR C             ; Clear carry flag before subtraction
MOV R1, A         ; Backup current maximum in R1
SUBB A, @R0       ; Subtract array element from Accumulator
JNC SKIP          ; If Acc was larger, no carry generated -> skip update

UPDATE:
MOV A, @R0        ; If array element was larger, load it as new max
SJMP NEXT

SKIP:
MOV A, R1         ; Restore the previous maximum back into Accumulator

NEXT:
INC R0            ; Point to next element
DJNZ R2, CHECK    ; Repeat for all elements

MOV R5, A         ; Store the final largest number in R5
END
